lines.text: At exactly eleven fifty-nine PM, a stranger walked into a gas station, and asked one question.
What time is it?
The cashier answered. One second later, the entire night started over.
Kai had been working alone for six hours.
The gas station was almost empty, and the nearest town was twenty miles away.
All he wanted was to finish his shift, and go home.
A man in a dark raincoat stepped inside. He didn't look at the shelves. He didn't buy anything.
He just stood near the door, completely motionless, before asking Kai for the time.
What time is it?
Eleven fifty-nine.
The lights blinked. The radio crackled.
And suddenly, Kai was cleaning the counter again. The clock read eleven fifty-seven.
At first, he thought he'd imagined it. Until the doorbell rang.
The stranger stopped in exactly the same spot. His clothes were just as wet. His voice sounded identical.
What time is it?
Kai hesitated, then answered again.
Eleven fifty-nine.
And the clock jumped backward.
Kai tried everything. He unplugged the radio. He moved a display stand. He even locked the front door.
But every time he answered the stranger's question, everything returned to exactly how it was.
What time is it?
Then Kai noticed something even stranger.
The security monitor was showing the last few minutes. But every time the loop restarted, a new recording appeared.
And in every recording, Kai was talking to someone the camera couldn't see.
Kai finally understood one thing. The loop only happened when he answered.
Every time he gave the stranger the time, the night repeated.
So this time, he decided to stay silent.
What time is it?
the stranger asked. Kai said nothing. The man took one step closer.
You heard me.
Kai kept staring at the clock. Twenty seconds remained until midnight.
The stranger leaned forward, and whispered.
Please. Just tell me.
Ten seconds.
Five.
Three.
Then the clock struck midnight.
Every light went out. And when they came back on... he was gone.
Kai ran outside, and never returned to that gas station.
The next morning, his manager reviewed the security footage. Thirty-seven recordings of the same minute.
In every single one, Kai was speaking to an empty doorway.
Except the last.
In that one... Kai was staring directly at the camera.
What time is it?
